Are you the butcher Luiten is looking for? 
As a deboner, you work in the deboning department and are responsible for the pre-processing and processing of meat. You do not slaughter animals, as Luiten does not do that. - Cutting the meat into portions. - Performing quality checks on the meat. - Preparing meat for further processing by removing non-meat parts (fat, veins, tendons). - Sorting meat scraps and waste. - Identifying and reporting deviations to the supervisor. 
You start at 6:00 AM and the end time is flexible. Usually, you work 8-hour shifts from Monday to Friday, but extra hours and extra days on the weekend are scheduled if operationally necessary. 
 Job Requirements 
 - You speak English and/or Dutch. - You have an eye for detail and work meticulously. - You have knowledge of meat and proven relevant work experience. - Preferably, you have completed a butcher's training program. - You can work in a team and independently. - You are able to work in a production environment with a temperature from 7 degrees. - You are available during peak periods (December and Easter). - Willingness to adhere to regulations regarding all visible jewelry, piercings, false nails/eyelashes, or nail polish, which are prohibited in food production environments. 
 Employment conditions 
 - €0.09 allowance per hour for working in a 7 degree environment - Annual December bonus of 3.25% of gross salary (with the condition of working at least 2 months at Luiten). - Employment contract with Charlie Works - Health Insurance - Housing at a close distance - Free electrical bike for transport to work paid by Luiten - Friendly, multi-cultural, proud colleagues with a heart for production and a passion for quality.
